name: GA4 Reports
examples: Traffic acquisition CSV using Session source / medium
Landing page CSV filtered to paid Google traffic
summary: GA4 traffic-acquisition and landing-page reports used to understand paid sessions, engagement, key events, and where ad traffic lands.
whatItContains: Session-scoped traffic-source dimensions, sessions, engaged sessions, engagement rate, average engagement time, landing pages, key events, session key-event rate, and revenue when configured.
whatAiCanDoWithIt: Compare paid traffic and engagement across periods
Identify landing pages receiving most paid sessions
Check whether meaningful key events are recording
Flag Ads-versus-GA4 gaps as investigation signals
accessMethod: Export from GA4 Reports using Share this report > Download file, or query through the Google Analytics Data API. Document the exact paid-traffic filter or session-scoped dimension used.
